desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on Russian strikes damaging Ukrainian energy infrastructure and targeting civilians, alongside Ukrainian ground-drone successes and a new wave of Iranian air-defense activity. The single most important thread is sustained Russian pressure on Ukraine’s power grid and civilian targets.

## MAIN THREADS
### Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy and civilians
- [@wartranslated](https://x.com/wartranslated/status/2120965938258264429) posted video of a Russian drone deliberately striking a civilian car.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120964462765134119) reported Kernel, Ukraine’s largest sunflower-oil producer, halting all extraction plants after Russian drone hits on facilities.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120963223914422380) shared Libkos footage showing extensive destruction at a DTEK thermal power plant from repeated Russian missile/drone strikes.

### Ukrainian drone operations
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120964942488535085) highlighted the StarGate evacuation drone rescuing a sixth wounded soldier under fire.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120963941342052763) reported 3rd Assault Brigade NC13 unit destroying a Russian command post, UAV site, and ammo shelter with ground drones.

### Iranian air-defense activity
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2120960108775534984) and [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2120958963797598466) reported UAV launch from Omidiyeh and heavy AA activity in Izeh, Khuzestan.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2120962619125223533) claimed US envoys Witkoff and Kushner received Russian national-team jackets during Moscow peace talks (unconfirmed).
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2120964215137780021) posted photo of a whale in the Hudson River (unconfirmed, non-defence).

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for follow-on Russian strikes on remaining Ukrainian power capacity and any escalation in Iranian AA activity tied to regional UAV launches. Ukrainian ground-drone tactics in Donetsk are also expected to draw further reporting.
